frequency_question: How often do major regional water-sharing treaties get successfully renewed or replaced with a formal successor agreement before or near their expiration date?
membership_rule: Includes formal transboundary river water treaties between South Asian nations facing expiration or renegotiation milestones; excludes minor municipal agreements or non-binding declarations.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and subsidiary negotiations

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; represents the core population of major bilateral South Asian water treaties.
known_gaps: Excludes minor ad-hoc joint committee extensions that lacked formal treaty status.
skeleton: Named three foundational water treaties in the region, noting that while negotiations are notoriously protracted, foundational framework agreements eventually achieve signature when existential agricultural pressures mount.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 3 major comparable foundational frameworks
validity_reason: Bilateral hydro-diplomacy structural dynamics in South Asia evolve slowly across decades.
